runs.evidence: Roots and grass at the top, then brown-grey weathered clayey material with pale carbonate-looking fragments; pale grey rock at the right end.
Pale grey-green, fine, banded; fractured with orange iron-oxide staining along fractures; weathered top.
Light grey, fine; broken angular pieces on the left, competent massive cylinders on the right.
Pale grey-green, homogeneous, smooth, massive; ochre oxidation and transverse fractures toward the right end.
Medium grey, massive, slightly rough surface with burrow-like mottling; one transverse fracture.
Grey-green with dark grey to black irregular clay seams and laminae; a fracture with dark filling.
Green-grey fine rock; competent piece on the left, then crushed fragments and debris (drilling-disturbed); empty liner at the right end. Label arithmetic: 21.95-18.6 = 3.35, label says 2.35.
Grey-green finely laminated core passing to dark brown-black, fissile, glossy laminated core; massive dark piece on the right. Start depth 21.6 overlaps Run 8 end (21.95).
Black to very dark grey, glossy (wet film or organic coating), massive to faintly banded; one lighter grey massive piece.
Pale blue-grey, finely laminated, with mm-scale dark streaks (bioturbation or organic/sulphide); last pieces broken.
